BiblicalUsage: Homam is an Edomite chieftain, a son of Lotan, and he stands in 1 Chronicles 1:39, in the genealogy of Esau's descendants. His name is spelled Hemam in the parallel telling of Esau's genealogy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Homam matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
